note: P4157 (Pro 21:5) — the plans of the diligent lead to abundance; the hasty come only to poverty.

dims.v: planning — the diligent's careful plans lead to abundance
the plans/purposes of the diligent, carefully made, that lead surely to abundance
(the hasty who come to poverty, by contrast)
the careful planning of the diligent set against reckless haste
machashabah (plan/purpose) — 'the PLANS of the diligent lead surely to abundance'; careful, diligent planning yields plenty, where haste brings only want. Diligence plans; folly rushes.
